scope: MuJoCo engineering transfer of the preserved 24-input/96-muscle projection; not a measured organism or physics parity with Webots

mechanics.coordinates: X forward, Y left, Z up; segment 01 tail to segment 24 head follows original named spine order
mechanics.limits: mass, shape, traction, motor gains and locomotion uncalibrated; no hidden supports

muscles.missing_packet: zero new muscle impulse; previous contraction decays; disarm after 100ms source-step age
muscles.zero_output: zero initial target/active effort; no injected twitch or gait

sensors.accel: segment 01 local proper acceleration, rotate Z-up axes to legacy Y-up, normalize [-20,20] m/s2
sensors.gyro: segment 01 local angular velocity, rotate to legacy axes, normalize [-10,10] rad/s
sensors.touch: terminal segment object contacts excluding ground and own body; reduced bumper proxy
sensors.light_heat: renderer lamp diffuse intensity / (1 + squared SI distance); heat uses red component. Ideal unoccluded field, uncalibrated, not temperature
sensors.taste_chemical_flow_far: named mounted ideal range rays with original PROTO directions/ranges, 1-distance/range; these are proximity proxies, not chemistry or fluid flow
sensors.mounts: nearest articulated segment; original pose transformed Y-up to Z-up

open_gates: production governed output commit and fencing
